description: Execute a read-only JSON-RPC 2.0 method on a specified blockchain network using your BlockVectra API key, or via the keyless public endpoint if available on the chain. Write methods (such as 'eth_sendRawTransaction') are not supported in rpc_call; use 'send_raw_transaction' instead. Consult the Ethereum JSON-RPC specification (https://ethereum.org/en/developers/docs/apis/json-rpc/) and the BlockVectra method reference (https://docs.blockvectra.com/en/api/json-rpc/methods/). Requires the 'x-api-key' or 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' HTTP header in your MCP client configuration for full access (keys must not be passed in tool parameters or chat). Returns the raw JSON-RPC response from the server.

chain.description: Target blockchain network slug (e.g. 'robinhood_mainnet'). Must exist in GET /v1/chains.

method.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 method name (e.g. 'eth_blockNumber', 'eth_call', 'eth_getLogs'). Write methods are not accepted.

params.description: Optional JSON-RPC parameter array. Defaults to [].

name: rpc_call

balance_units.description: Remaining balance units after this request (only present when balance is known and x-bv-meter: 1 was sent).

cu_charged.description: Compute Units billed for this request (only present when charged and x-bv-meter: 1 was sent).

signup_url.description: Registration and sign-up URL (returned when rate-limited on the public endpoint).

title: Call JSON-RPC Method
